description: The signed-in couple's own guest list on Zola, searched by a part of the name, by event, and by RSVP answer. Gives each guest's name, household, side, and answers to each event. Gives no email, phone number, or address. To change a household, give its guest_group_id and guest_group_version to zola_update_my_guest. For the counts only, use zola_get_my_rsvp_overview. For an event_id, use zola_get_my_wedding_events. Requires Zola sign-in (guests:read).

event_id.description: The event_id of zola_get_my_wedding_events: only the guests invited to that event, with their answer to it.

limit.description: The most guests to give, 1 to 50. The default is 25.

query.description: A part of the guest's name, for example "Lee" or "Sam Lee". Leave it out for every guest.

rsvp.description: Only the guests with this answer.

name: zola_search_my_guests

outputSchema.description: The guests of the signed-in couple that match the search

event_found.description: With event_id: false when the wedding has no such event. Null with no event_id

exists.description: False when the guest list has no guests

guests.description: In the order of the guest list. No email, phone number, or address

affiliation.description: The side of the household: first_partner is the partner who made the Zola account

guest_group_version.description: The version of the household. Give it as the version of zola_update_my_guest

relationship.description: main_guest of the household, partner (a plus-one or a spouse), or child

rsvp.description: With event_id: the answer to that event. Else the overall answer, or the answer from the events when the guest has no overall answer

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

matched.description: The guests that match, before the limit

truncated.description: True when the limit cut the list: narrow the search or raise limit

title: Search My Guest List
